create.name: Elena Brower
create.bio:
Elena Brower has taught yoga and meditation for close to thirty years and has taught online classes on the Glo platform since 2008. Her approach joins steady physical practice with sitting meditation, journaling and close attention to how we speak, parent and work. In recent years her practice has deepened in Zen: she took lay vows in the Shunryu Suzuki lineage, finished chaplaincy training at Upaya in 2026, and now volunteers as a chaplain in hospices and prisons.

She is also a painter and writer. Her books include Art of Attention, the guided journals Practice You and Being You, a poetry collection, and Hold Nothing, published by Shambhala in 2025, and she writes a regular Substack under the same name. She hosts the long-running Practice You podcast, which mixes her own reflections with conversations about presence and care. Students can join her self-paced online courses, a journaling and yoga circle, private mentoring, and residential retreats in Costa Rica and New Mexico. Proceeds from some of her work go to the charities supported by her Hold Nothing Foundation.

books.title: Practice You: A Journal
books.author: Elena Brower
books.description: A guided journal of questions, short readings and open pages for writing. It asks the reader to notice what supports them and to build a daily practice of reflection from their own answers.

books.title: Practice You Daily Awakening Deck
books.author: Elena Brower
books.description: A boxed set of practice cards that can be used alongside the Practice You journal or alone. Each card offers a short meditation, prayer, movement or writing prompt for the day.

courses.title: Innermost Wisdom Costa Rica Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit in Costa Rica with morning yoga and meditation, quieter afternoon sessions of yin, restorative poses and Zen sitting, and optional writing. Taught with Marc Holzman for a small group.

courses.title: Simplify
courses.description: A self-paced audio course in six modules with worksheets, on paring back schedules, habits and commitments. It draws on her years of practice, writing and running a business.

courses.title: Being You Practice Circle
courses.description: Nine recorded sessions that work through her journal Being You, each with yoga postures, meditation and writing. Postures come with options for beginners, and proceeds help a community food kitchen.

courses.title: 1:1 Mentorship with Elena
courses.description: Private mentoring sessions covering practice, work and family life. Enquiries go through her contact form.

free_resources.title: Meditation for Big Moments
free_resources.description: A short guided meditation to settle the mind before an important occasion, sent free by email.

free_resources.title: Meditation for Ease in Times of Change
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation for steadiness during transitions, delivered by email.

free_resources.title: Rituals for Reality
free_resources.description: A free seven-day email guide to shaping a few simple daily rituals for a calmer mind.
